Build me a compact, sunlit Hong Kong neighborhood fragment suspended against an open blue-sky backdrop, with roughly twenty tightly packed mid-rise residential and mixed-use buildings arranged organically along two narrow streets that meet at a small offset intersection. Form the scene as an irregular L- or cross-shaped urban island with no surrounding terrain: sidewalks, roads, and buildings end abruptly at sheer vertical cut edges, exposing plain building backs above an empty pale-blue void. Use mostly six- to ten-story concrete apartment blocks with flat roofs, muted pink, cream, gray, brown, and green stucco or tile façades, narrow gaps, varied setbacks, and occasional rounded street corners. Face the detailed façades inward toward the roads while leaving outward-facing sides as tall, largely blank walls. Fill the inner streets with yellow curb lines, white lane markings, yellow zebra crossings, small traffic islands, railings, bollards, signs, lamps, hydrants, bins, utility boxes, manholes, and a fenced orange roadwork area with barriers and cones. Make the ground floors a continuous, cluttered strip of shuttered storefronts, recessed doors, awnings, Chinese and English signs, graffiti, lanterns, and hanging pennant flags. Cover upper façades with gridded metal-framed windows, enclosed balconies, projecting air-conditioning units, drainpipes, cables, laundry racks, and colorful clothes. Crowd the flat rooftops with corrugated extensions, water or utility housings, railings, antenna frames, satellite dishes, ducts, and small mechanical boxes. Keep the urban core richly detailed and convincingly dense, but let the block perimeter terminate unevenly and starkly in simple wall masses.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt: Build me a compact, sunlit Hong Kong neighborhood fragment suspended against an open blue-sky backdrop, with roughly twenty tightly packed mid-rise residential and mixed-use buildings arranged organically along two narrow streets that meet at a small offset intersection. Form the scene as an irregular L- or cross-shaped urban island with no surrounding terrain: sidewalks, roads, and buildings end abruptly at sheer vertical cut edges, exposing plain building backs above an empty pale-blue void. Use mostly six- to ten-story concrete apartment blocks with flat roofs, muted pink, cream, gray, brown, and green stucco or tile façades, narrow gaps, varied setbacks, and occasional rounded street corners. Face the detailed façades inward toward the roads while leaving outward-facing sides as tall, largely blank walls. Fill the inner streets with yellow curb lines, white lane markings, yellow zebra crossings, small traffic islands, railings, bollards, signs, lamps, hydrants, bins, utility boxes, manholes, and a fenced orange roadwork area with barriers and cones. Make the ground floors a continuous, cluttered strip of shuttered storefronts, recessed doors, awnings, Chinese and English signs, graffiti, lanterns, and hanging pennant flags. Cover upper façades with gridded metal-framed windows, enclosed balconies, projecting air-conditioning units, drainpipes, cables, laundry racks, and colorful clothes. Crowd the flat rooftops with corrugated extensions, water or utility housings, railings, antenna frames, satellite dishes, ducts, and small mechanical boxes. Keep the urban core richly detailed and convincingly dense, but let the block perimeter terminate unevenly and starkly in simple wall masses.
